list_cens.title: List CEN instances
list_cens.description: List Cloud Enterprise Network instances with their status and protection level. Start here to find a cen_id.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

output.description: The CEN instances and the total count.

create_cen.title: Create a CEN instance
create_cen.description: Create a Cloud Enterprise Network instance; then add transit routers and attach networks to it.

protection_level.description: CIDR overlap protection; REDUCED allows overlapping CIDRs.

update_cen.title: Update a CEN instance
update_cen.description: Rename a CEN instance or change its description or protection level.

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

delete_cen.title: Delete a CEN instance
delete_cen.description: Delete a CEN instance. Its networks must be detached and its transit routers and bandwidth plans removed first.

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

list_attached_networks.title: List attached networks
list_attached_networks.description: List the VPCs, VBRs and CCN instances attached to a CEN instance (Basic Edition attachments).

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

attach_network.title: Attach a network
attach_network.description: Attach a VPC, VBR or CCN instance to a CEN instance (Basic Edition). For Enterprise Edition use create_vpc_attachment.

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

detach_network.title: Detach a network
detach_network.description: Detach a network from a CEN instance; routes to and from it are withdrawn.

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

list_region_routes.title: List routes in a region
list_region_routes.description: List the routes a CEN instance has learned in one region, with their next hops and status.

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

list_bandwidth_packages.title: List bandwidth plans
list_bandwidth_packages.description: List CEN bandwidth plans with their bandwidth, regions and the CEN instance they are bound to.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

is_or_key.description: Combine filters with OR instead of AND.

list_child_instance_regions.title: List attachable regions
list_child_instance_regions.description: List the regions whose networks can be attached to CEN.

list_transit_routers.title: List transit routers
list_transit_routers.description: List the transit routers of a CEN instance, optionally in one region, with their type and status.

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

create_transit_router.title: Create a transit router
create_transit_router.description: Create an Enterprise Edition transit router for a CEN instance in one region.

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

dry_run.description: Only check the request; change nothing.

delete_transit_router.title: Delete a transit router
delete_transit_router.description: Delete a transit router. Its attachments and custom route tables must be removed first.

transit_router_id.description: The transit router ID, e.g. tr-bp1su1ytdxtataupl****.

dry_run.description: Only check the request; change nothing.

list_available_resources.title: List transit router zones
list_available_resources.description: List the zones in a region where a transit router can attach VPC vSwitches.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

list_vpc_attachments.title: List VPC attachments
list_vpc_attachments.description: List the VPC connections of a transit router, with their vSwitches, status and route settings.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

output.description: The VPC attachments and a NextToken.

create_vpc_attachment.title: Attach a VPC to a transit router
create_vpc_attachment.description: Connect a VPC to an Enterprise Edition transit router through vSwitches in two zones.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

transit_router_id.description: The transit router ID, e.g. tr-bp1su1ytdxtataupl****.

vswitch_1_id.description: A vSwitch in the first zone.

vswitch_2_id.description: A vSwitch in the second zone.

auto_publish_route_enabled.description: Publish the VPC's routes to the transit router automatically.

dry_run.description: Only check the request; change nothing.

delete_vpc_attachment.title: Detach a VPC
delete_vpc_attachment.description: Remove a VPC connection from a transit router; traffic between that VPC and the rest of the network stops.

force.description: Also remove its route entries and associations.

dry_run.description: Only check the request; change nothing.

list_peer_attachments.title: List inter-region connections
list_peer_attachments.description: List the connections between transit routers in different regions, with their bandwidth and status.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

output.description: The inter-region connections and a NextToken.

create_peer_attachment.title: Connect two regions
create_peer_attachment.description: Create an inter-region connection between two transit routers. Bandwidth comes from a bandwidth plan or pay-by-data-transfer.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

transit_router_id.description: The transit router ID, e.g. tr-bp1su1ytdxtataupl****.

dry_run.description: Only check the request; change nothing.

list_route_tables.title: List route tables
list_route_tables.description: List a transit router's route tables, including the system table and custom ones.

transit_router_id.description: The transit router ID, e.g. tr-bp1su1ytdxtataupl****.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

output.description: The route tables and a NextToken.

list_route_entries.title: List routes
list_route_entries.description: List the routes in a transit router route table, with destination, next hop, type and status.

route_table_id.description: The transit router route table ID, e.g. vtb-bp1dudbh2d5na6b50****.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.

create_route_entry.title: Add a static route
create_route_entry.description: Add a static route to a transit router route table, pointing at an attachment or blackholing the destination.

route_table_id.description: The transit router route table ID, e.g. vtb-bp1dudbh2d5na6b50****.

next_hop_type.description: Attachment forwards to a connection; BlackHole drops traffic.

dry_run.description: Only check the request; change nothing.

delete_route_entry.title: Delete a static route
delete_route_entry.description: Delete a static route from a transit router route table.

dry_run.description: Only check the request; change nothing.

list_flow_logs.title: List flow logs
list_flow_logs.description: List CEN flow logs, which record traffic through transit routers to Simple Log Service.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

list_grants.title: List cross-account grants
list_grants.description: List the networks other accounts have authorized a CEN instance to attach.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

cen_id.description: The CEN instance ID, e.g. cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc****.

next_token.description: The token from the previous page's NextToken; omit for the first page.
